controles.affirmation: BPA ajuste +18% (2,42 a 2,86 USD) contre BPA GAAP +6% (1,97 a 2,09 USD) au T2 FY2026
controles.verbatim_source: "EPS GAAP $1.97 $2.09 6%" ; "EPS Adjusted* $2.42 $2.86 18%". Investor Presentation datee du 21 mai 2026 (data-lake/NDSN/EP/NDSN_2026-05-21_EP.pdf).
controles.correction_proposee: L'ATT date cette presentation du 20 mai 2026 dans ses preuves ; la page de garde porte "Investor Presentation May 21, 2026" (le 8-K de resultats est du 20 mai 2026).

controles.affirmation: Charge de reglement de retraite de 24,0 M USD comptabilisee uniquement ce trimestre, absente au T2 FY2025, liee a l'annuitisation d'un passif de 113 M USD
controles.verbatim_source: "Pension settlement charge ( 24,049 ) --- ( 24,049 ) ---" (10-Q T2 FY2026, Consolidated Statements of Income, trois et six mois) ; "Annuitized $113 million liability at a 7.5% discount" (Investor Presentation).

controles.affirmation: Goodwill 3,33 Mds USD et incorporels nets 0,65 Md USD, soit 3,98 Mds USD = 67% du bilan (5,96 Mds) et 124% des capitaux propres (3,20 Mds) ; 131% au 31 octobre 2025
L'ecart BPA ajuste / BPA GAAP passe d'une prime de 22,8% (0,45 USD) au T2 FY2025 a 36,8% (0,77 USD) au T2 FY2026
controles.verbatim_source: Derive des memes chiffres : 2,42 - 1,97 = 0,45 soit 22,8% de 1,97 ; 2,86 - 2,09 = 0,77 soit 36,8% de 2,09.

controles.affirmation: Citation "Segment EBITDA for IPS decreased 200 basis points despite higher sales due to unfavorable pricing" (10-Q T2 FY2026, MD&A, six months ended April 30, 2026)
controles.verbatim_source: Le 10-Q ecrit : "Six Months Ended April 30, 2026 Segment EBITDA for IPS decreased 200 basis points despite higher sales due to unfavorable product and geographic mix in the first quarter." Le mot "pricing" n'apparait pas et le repli est explicitement date du seul premier trimestre. Pour le trimestre : "Three Months Ended April 30, 2026 Segment EBITDA for IPS was relatively flat on higher sales."
controles.correction_proposee: Retablir la citation exacte et l'argument : "la societe attribue ce recul a un mix produit et geographique defavorable, concentre sur le premier trimestre ; au T2 le 10-Q qualifie l'EBITDA du segment IPS de relativement stable sur des ventes en hausse". Supprimer la mention d'un "mix prix defavorable".

controles.affirmation: Marge EBITDA segment IPS de 36,5% a 34,5% sur 6 mois (-200 pb), MFS de 35,5% a 36,8% (+130 pb), ATS de 22,0% a 24,8% (+280 pb)
controles.verbatim_source: "Six Months Ended ... Industrial precision solutions $ 233,889 34.5% $ 226,324 36.5% (2.0)% ; Medical and fluid solutions 149,399 36.8% 140,870 35.5% 1.3% ; Advanced technology solutions 80,927 24.8% 62,287 22.0% 2.8%" (10-Q T2 FY2026, note segments).

controles.affirmation: IPS represente 48% du CA du groupe sur les 6 premiers mois ; ATS 24% du CA au T2 FY2026
controles.verbatim_source: Derive de la note segments : IPS 6 mois 233 889 / 34,5% = 677,9 M USD sur 1 410 308 = 48,1% ; ATS T2 48 327 / 27,2% = 177,7 M USD sur 740 847 = 24,0%.

controles.verbatim_source: "A portion of our product sales is attributable to industries and markets, such as the electronics, polymer processing, agriculture and metal finishing industries, which historically have been cyclical and sensitive to relative changes in supply and demand and general economic conditions." 10-K FY2025 (data-lake/NDSN/10K/NDSN_2025-12-17.htm.gz), Item 1A.
